name: Are there specific repairs Denver-area buyers watch for during turnover inspections?

mainEntity.name: Are there specific repairs Denver-area buyers watch for during turnover inspections?

acceptedAnswer.text: Throughout Denver, Centennial, and Parker, older homes frequently feature settling cracks around door frames and settlement movement in basements due to regional expansive soils. Prospective buyers in these markets are alert to structural signs, so properly repairing hairline drywall cracks, realigning misaligned interior doors, and repairing cracked floor tiles is critical. Ensuring that cosmetic settling cracks are cleanly patched and door latches catch properly eliminates unnecessary buyer anxiety during home inspections across the Denver metro area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Denver buyers often look for movement cracks in drywall, misaligned doors, and cracked tile caused by regional soils, making proper patching and door realignment essential.
